---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

```{python}
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```

The dataset includes James Bond films from `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` to `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`. @fig-bond shows their worldwide revenue over time.

```{python}
#| label: fig-bond
#| fig-cap: "Worldwide revenue of the James Bond films (millions of US dollars)"

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
ax.set_xlabel("Year")
ax.set_ylabel("Revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
